slogan: Live in the dark. Get back before dawn.
meta_aciklama: Raid the sun-scorched surface at night, get back before dawn and build an underground colony. A survival colony game for Android.
fragman_a: The sun turned deadly. This is how the survivors live.
hikaye_a: Three weeks was all it took.
h1: The ozone layer tore open in three weeks. Daylight became a killer, and the cities emptied.
h2: Metro tunnels and mine shafts became shelters. You lead one of them.
h3b: Those left in the light didn't die
h3: They changed. Now they roam the surface at night, and they hear everything.
h4: Ships in orbit turned the sun into a weapon. At dawn they drop their robots to claim the surface.
h5: The robots sealed a colony shuttle at the Spaceport. Repair it, launch it and lead your people to a new world.
oz_a: Greed by night, home by dawn.
o1: Go up after dark, loot crates and buildings, and race back to the elevator before sunrise burns you.
o2: Rare crates, legendary weapons, gear and blueprints. Every night is a gamble between greed and fear.
o3: Fight with guns, grenades, EMP and smoke, or slip through the shadows. A squad of soldiers can join you.
o4: Dig a three-floor shelter for up to 200 people: generators, water, greenhouses, barns, labs, barracks.
o5: Children grow up, elders age, crises come. Every choice has a price.
o6: When the horde comes, your guards hold the entrance and reinforcements run from the barracks.
b_a: Each one deadlier, and richer, than the last.
b1: A suburb sinking into desert sand. Every colony starts here.
b2: Shopfronts and dead neon: the mutants' city.
b4: Rusted docks, sealed hangars and the last shuttle.
rc_a: Raids, enemies, weapons, rooms, colony management, defense and the New World: every system explained in detail.
s1: Android first (Google Play). iOS and PC are planned.
s2: Yes, it's free to play. Nothing in the game sells power: weapons and gear are only found on the surface.
s3s: Do I need an internet connection?
s3: No. The game plays fully offline; your saves stay on your device.
s4: English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, 日本語 and 한국어.
son_a: Be among the first to play: join the closed test on Google Play.
rehber_giris: Go up at night, get back before dawn, build a colony underground. Every system in Shadow Colony, from the first night to the New World.
rehber_meta: The official Shadow Colony game guide: night raids, enemies, weapons, shelter rooms, colony management, defense, progression and the New World.
